negative_controls.identity: BA = 0.5 * decision coverage on identical opposite-label inputs; ties count wrong.

data.inference: Three paired independently fitted seeds;20000 whole-block bootstrap resamples,seed3991900001;pointwise unadjusted95% intervals. Eight nominal alternative-objective-minus-CE primary comparisons. All settings retained. No broad superiority or unique-cause claim.

metric_definitions.correct_coverage: Fraction of all episodes correctly decided; equals accuracy here.
metric_definitions.decision_coverage: Fraction with unequal native query counts.
metric_definitions.conditional_accuracy: Correct / decided; undefined when no decisions.

data.gradient_diagnostic_scope: Stored raw parameter-gradient components precede clipping and Adam; norms and cosines do not measure their individual contributions to nonlinear optimizer updates. Alternative objectives pay for21 additional diagnostic backwards; training updates remain400 for all.
